As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento. Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador. Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- 🇺🇸 **English:** The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: Frost-Free Favorites AZ 2025
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FrostFreeFavoritesAZ2025#67008-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab. ### Please note that this is a "Favorites" style competition Since this is a "Favorites" competition, you may choose at most **five (5) events**. If you are unfamiliar with this style of a competition, please read the "[What is a Favorites Competition?](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FrostFreeFavoritesAZ2025#67007-what-is-a-favorites-competition)" tab. Due to the style of this competition, the schedule may change after registration has closed to allot the appropriate amount of time to each event based on registration numbers. Due to scheduling so many events, we have a few events that overlap. You can still register to compete in both events; you will just do one event's solves and upon finishing, compete in the other event. ### Please note that competitors are limited to 1 guest each. This is due to venue space and limited seating available. ### Connect with the Arizona cubing community! Instagram: [@arizonacubing](https://www.instagram.com/arizonacubing/) Facebook Group: [Arizona Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/arizonacubing)

items.information: 🟥🟨🟩 **¡Bienvenidos al Campeonato Nacional de Bolivia 2025!** 🟥🟨🟩 Este año celebramos con orgullo el décimo aniversario desde las primeras competencias oficiales en Bolivia, que dieron inicio a nuestra comunidad.
